notebooks.execution_method: Executed all 20 code cells sequentially from an empty in-process IPython namespace with scripts/execute_notebook_inprocess.py and public PyPI installations of NeqSim, XTGeo, and XTGeoViz. The final clean run completed in 20.9 seconds, retained every result-bearing output, stored six PNG figures, and produced zero error outputs or stderr.

open_data.dataset: Synthetic SPE9 benchmark EGRID, INIT, DATA, and INITSOL files
open_data.integrity: All four files are downloaded from immutable commit URLs and verified against embedded SHA-256 checksums.
